why_selected: The model's canonical growth objective -- included as the baseline everything else is compared against.
Non-growth-associated maintenance ATP demand -- a standard alternative FBA objective distinct from growth.
Acetate -- classic E. coli overflow-metabolism secretion product under excess glucose/aerobic conditions.
Formate -- classic mixed-acid fermentation product (pyruvate-formate lyase pathway).
D-lactate -- classic mixed-acid fermentation product, industrially relevant (bioplastics feedstock).
Succinate -- fermentation/TCA-branch product, industrially relevant bio-based chemical.
Pyruvate -- central metabolic branch-point metabolite; secretion capacity probes glycolysis/TCA balance.
Fumarate -- TCA-cycle intermediate, also an anaerobic electron-acceptor product.
CO2 -- terminal respiration/fermentation byproduct; secretion capacity reflects the aerobic/anaerobic balance chosen by the solution.
